# Ticket 33: paths TruffleHog's docker source skips in the `build` job's
# image scan. One per line:
#
#   <path glob> <expiry YYYY-MM-DD> <reason>
#
# The globs become `--exclude-paths` (absolute paths inside the image). Every
# entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry stops applying, so the
# finding blocks again until someone re-reviews it. Never exclude a real
# credential: rotate it instead.

# The distroless base's dpkg checksum lists: md5 hashes trip the Box
# detector (seen on libc6.md5sums). Not secrets.
